app.title: HA Climate
app.engineUnavailable: The engine is not responding (starting or restarting). Live data and some actions are unavailable until it is back.
app.bootFailed: The add-on could not be reached.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Network error: the add-on cannot be reached.

codes.no_active_mode: Nothing to boost: no device of this room works in the current season.
codes.paused: HA Climate is paused: resume it to boost a room.
codes.preset_in_use: This preset is still used by a schedule or by a system rule.
codes.preset_exists: A preset with this key already exists.

guard.title: Discard your changes?
guard.message: You have unsaved changes. If you leave this page they will be lost.

pause.stateActive: Rooms are driven according to their schedules.
pause.statePaused: Paused: nothing is sent to your devices.
pause.explain: While paused, HA Climate keeps watching your home and deciding (the history shows what it would have done) but sends nothing: no heating or cooling command, no notification. Use your devices freely, then resume.
pause.banner: HA Climate is paused: no action is sent, the history carries on.
pause.boostDisabled: Boosts are unavailable while HA Climate is paused.

entity_unavailable.title: Sensor unavailable · {room}
entity_unavailable.body: {entity} has not been answering since {since}. A persistent notification may have been created in Home Assistant.

device_unresponsive.title: Device not responding · {room}
device_unresponsive.body: {entity} did not apply the last command (since {since}).

reason.season_off: Season is “Off”: no device is driven.
reason.no_device: No device is configured for this mode in this room.
reason.no_schedule: No schedule is assigned to this room for the current season.
reason.no_rule: No rule applies: the device is left alone.
reason.house_empty: House empty since {since}: everything is off.
reason.opening_open: Window open since {since}: device off, it restarts when the window closes.
reason.boost: Boost {delta} requested from the interface, ends {until}.
reason.manual_override: Target changed on the device: the schedule resumes at {until}.
reason.room_vacant: Room vacant since {since}: {preset} until someone comes back.

rooms.select: Select a room, or add one.
rooms.deleteMessage: The room, its devices and its settings will be removed. This cannot be undone.
rooms.name: Name
rooms.sensorsHint: Entities discovered in Home Assistant, filtered on the room's area.
rooms.openingsHelp: Listed sensors: binary_sensor with the Window, Door, Opening or Garage door class, and input_boolean. A sensor without a class (a group, for instance) is not listed: set its class with “Show as” in Home Assistant.
rooms.devicesHint: Anti-cycling: a command that does not respect the minimum durations is delayed and noted in the history.
rooms.presetTempsHint: Schedules pick a preset; each room decides the matching temperature, in winter and in summer.
rooms.vacancyDelay: Vacant room → switch to Eco after
rooms.preheatHint: Starts early to reach the target at the slot's time, based on the room's learned speed.

schedules.usedByHint: Each room applies its own temperatures for every preset.
schedules.unused: Not used by any room yet.
schedules.empty: No schedule yet. Create one, then pick it in each room’s settings.
schedules.notFound: This schedule does not exist (it may have been deleted).
schedules.name: Name
schedules.fallback: Time if the entity is unavailable
schedules.slotHint: A slot always ends where the next one starts. An anchored slot follows its entity: if the bedtime moves, the switch to Night moves with it, and so does the next day's preheating.
schedules.duplicateStarts: Two slots of the same day start at the same time.
schedules.deleteUsed: Used by {rooms}. These rooms will be switched off for the season of this schedule.
schedules.deleteUnused: This schedule is not used by any room.

settings.seasonHint: Winter: only heating devices are driven. Summer: only cooling. A reversible device follows the season.
settings.presenceHint: People discovered in Home Assistant. The house is empty when all tracked people are away.
settings.houseEmpty: Switch everything off when the house has been empty for
settings.vacationHint: Everything goes to Away or Off, then restarts before you return, preheating included.
settings.manualHint: A target changed in Home Assistant or on the device is respected like a boost, then the schedule resumes.
settings.presetKeyHint: The key (a-z, 0-9, _) cannot be changed once the preset is created.
settings.presetDeleteMessage: A preset used by a schedule cannot be deleted.
settings.uiLocale: Default interface language (for users without a personal choice)
settings.displayHint: Your language (header) and theme are remembered for each Home Assistant user.
settings.auditCount: {count} entries · the oldest are purged every night.
settings.backupHint: Rooms, devices, presets, schedules, settings and notifications in a JSON file. Home Assistant backups already include the add-on.
settings.importReplaces: Importing replaces the whole current configuration.
settings.importWarning: Importing “{name}” replaces every room, schedule, preset and setting. This cannot be undone.
settings.importInvalid: This file is not a valid JSON document.
settings.importRejected: This file is not a valid HA Climate backup.

notifications.targetsHint: notify services discovered in Home Assistant.
notifications.testSaveFirst: Save your changes before sending a test.
notifications.typesHint: Each type is enabled separately. A given alert is sent only once, even after a restart.
notifications.persistent: Also create a persistent notification in Home Assistant (removed when the sensor is back)

window_open.title: Window left open
window_open.desc: Sent when an opening stays open beyond the room's second delay.
window_open.example: Bathroom: the window has been open for 30 min.

setpoint_not_applicable.title: Target cannot be applied
setpoint_not_applicable.desc: The requested target cannot be applied (window open, no device for the season…).
setpoint_not_applicable.example: Bathroom: the 22.0 °C target cannot be applied, the window is open.

device_unresponsive.title: Device not responding
device_unresponsive.desc: A command was sent but the device state did not change.
device_unresponsive.example: Living room: climate.living_room_radiator did not apply 21.0 °C after 5 min.

sensor_unavailable.title: Sensor unavailable
sensor_unavailable.desc: A sensor used by a room becomes unavailable or unknown.
sensor_unavailable.example: Master bedroom: sensor.master_bedroom_temperature has been unavailable since 14:02.

picker.search: Search by name, entity or area
picker.showAll: Also show entities from other areas ({count})
picker.searchEverywhere: Search in every area ({count} more entities)

signals.title: Presence signals
signals.hint: What tells HA Climate that the room is in use: a motion sensor, a light, a TV, a computer, a phone located by Bermuda…
signals.help: The room is occupied as long as one signal is active. Otherwise it is vacant since the most recent activity, and the vacancy delay then applies. A light left on keeps the room occupied. An unavailable signal is ignored. Without any signal, the room is never set back for vacancy.
signals.none: No signal: the room is never set back for vacancy.
signals.valuePlaceholder: Value, for example an area name

hints.active: Occupied while the entity is on (or playing).
hints.above: Occupied while the value is above {threshold} {unit}.
